reviews.comment: He is a very hilarious professor and would often try to connect concepts, ideas, and earth's history with each other. His lecture slides doesn't help a lot when trying to study for his exams but going to class is very important since he will often talk about a concept more than usual which is a hint that it will be on exam. Random attendance quizz
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Perez is a super solid prof. He's funny and light on hw and he makes his lectures creative and interesting. He's really nice in office hrs and he gives hard tests but they're doable if you focus on an overall understanding rather than knowing details but not knowing how they relate to each other.

Dr. Perez is an amazing professor. He often teaches based on students interests and explains everything in a very digestible manner. You need to come to class, though, since he grades based on what he teaches in lecture. Very accommodating, office hours are super helpful, such an awesome guy. I would definitely recommend him.

Dr Perez is the best professor that I have had in college. In my experience, most professors that I have had don't care about us. With Dr Perez, there is a sense that he cares for his students, and he wants nothing but the best for them. I actively strive to increase my knowledge because Dr Perez inspires me to do so.

I would not recommend this professor. Not only is he arrogant, but he provides no help at all. Good luck trying to talk or reason with him. I learned nothing valuable from this course and I will never take a class with this professor again. Very hard to get along with.
Hard class but he makes up for it by how funny he is. Lots of scientific papers you have to read outside class so get ready to read A LOT. Don't skip, and definitely don't fall asleep
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Took this class in Spring '19. Looking back, Dr. Perez is one of the best professors in the program. Easily one of the best professors at conveying fundamental geologic knowledge/topcis. Much of what he will teach you in 152 will come back around in later classes, and he did such a good job that you will be more than prepared for them. Great prof!

Almost all the material is in class. No textbook but he does assign scientific paper reading assignments as his "textbook". Accessible outside of class usually. Very funny guy and explains the topics very well and connects multiple topics together to paint a clearer image. In classes quizzes are not hard if you stay up with the reading assignments.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: No textbook. Accessible office hours. Quirky, funny guy in a quiet sort of way? Since the class is so focused on visual identification, it can be difficult to understand it the first time but he does a fairly good job of explaining the structures. I got below average on one test and still got an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY
